title: Add Maps Support
rationale: The included calf-maps project contains only its build file and no source/API. This is a valid unimplemented feature request, not a regression in an existing Maps implementation.
recommended_next_step: Keep maps requirements in the scaffold/capability issue; define platform/API scope and feasibility before implementation.

title: Camera issue in webview iOS
rationale: The 2023 report concerns camera presentation inside WKWebView, not calf-camera-picker. No current device reproduction or exact causal line is available. WKWebView still has delegate/presentation integration, so archive the report rather than treating it as resolved or confirmed.
recommended_next_step: Reproduce web-page camera capture/cancel on current iOS hardware and iPad with a minimal page; record whether host/navigation or permission delegates dismiss the view.

title: Webview not loading html content
rationale: The old Desktop QuantumRenderer/no-pipeline symptom remains a host-dependent reproduction target. The 2023 web-loading half predates the current 2026 iframe implementation and is not proof that the same bug remains. Native-feature startup risk already references this report.
recommended_next_step: Combine desktop startup checks with #151/#346 in NATIVE-018; separately retest the old web claim with an allowed-origin minimal iframe before calling it current.

title: Zoom in/out in browser
rationale: Browser zoom/focus mismatch was reported against the 2024 rendering stack. The baseline sample now enters ComposeViewport and no exact current library-level coordinate bug is demonstrated by the report. The maintainer asked whether this was Desktop in comment1975890950; the actual host remains ambiguous in the archived exchange.
recommended_next_step: Add current JS/Wasm zoom/devicePixelRatio/pointer/keyboard smoke reproduction on Chromium, Firefox and Safari; route to Compose/Skiko if library-independent. First confirm whether the original reporter meant browser or desktop WebView zoom.

title: Contacts and OTP feature
rationale: Read/write contacts and SMS permission properties exist, but permission authorization is not contacts retrieval or OTP reading/autofill. The upstream maintainer comment 2378840675 promised a contacts permission via PR181, not a complete contacts/OTP API.
recommended_next_step: Document partial fulfillment and decide separately whether contacts/OTP data APIs belong in scope; use least-privilege platform autofill/retriever approaches rather than blanket SMS reading.

title: Webview not work on Linux
rationale: Ubuntu24.04 JavaFX QuantumRenderer startup failure is a credible historical report but has not been reproduced in the current baseline environment. Native-feature startup risk and host classifier/build investigation cover it; it is not a second confirmed root cause.
recommended_next_step: Retest packaged JavaFX19 on clean Ubuntu/display/CPU combinations and collect rendering-native-dependency evidence; consolidate with #39/#346.

title: Custom data source media content
rationale: Media is an excluded build-only project. Custom Android DataSource or iOS AVAssetResourceLoader cannot be added to a functioning media module because none exists. Keep it as a future API requirement, not a current media defect.
recommended_next_step: Preserve custom/streaming resource injection as a media roadmap requirement under the scaffold/capability issue; evaluate module scope first.

title: Demonstration of AdaptiveCircularProgressIndicator in AdaptiveAlertDialog
rationale: Common alert exposes materialText/materialContent slots but iOS uses native UIAlertController descriptors and text. The requested adaptive busy/progress-dialog example is not available as a uniform arbitrary native Compose content slot.
recommended_next_step: Design/document an explicit busy-dialog example with cancel/accessibility semantics and a deliberate iOS presentation strategy; avoid silently inserting unsupported Material content into UIKit.

title: Request this library can take camera
rationale: Android and iOS camera capture code exists in the baseline (PR274 and later PR326). The feature request is source-satisfied, but capture has separately tracked correctness/setup/lifecycle risks; no device pass is claimed.
recommended_next_step: Point documentation to existing camera API/setup and native camera findings; do not recreate a duplicate request to add the already existing Android/iOS module.

title: firebase compatibility
rationale: KmpFile is a platform handle, not a portable Firebase filesystem path. readByteArray and source are available, but mobile URI/path metadata and eager-buffer guidance are already audited. Firebase integration itself is a consumer adapter/documentation question, not a confirmed Firebase defect.
recommended_next_step: Add an integration recipe distinguishing Android URI, iOS readable copy and byte/stream upload; keep Firebase out of core dependencies and link IO-014/IO-021.

title: Support native file preview
rationale: No dedicated native file-preview API/module exists. Desktop share opening a file is not a portable preview abstraction or iOS Quick Look implementation.
recommended_next_step: Record native preview as an opt-in future module: define unsupported/cancel/error behavior, file-access lifetime and platform viewer capabilities before selecting dependencies.

title: [BUG] WebView throwing error on configuration
rationale: The historical stack shows direct JavaFX settings writes on AWT-EventQueue. Baseline applySettings now wraps writes in Platform.runLater at lines215-221, so this specific cause is source-addressed. That does not prove all current JavaFX lifecycle/thread paths are correct.
recommended_next_step: Keep a settings-on-EDT regression test in the desktop matrix; do not recreate the old wrong-thread-settings bug as confirmed. Track distinct startup/lifecycle risks through NATIVE-018/NATIVE-002.

title: [BUG] Reentry into ignoringRedrawRequests is not allowed (WebView)
rationale: The historical stack traces JFXPanel.initFx nested Swing event-loop reentry during Compose render. Baseline still constructs JFXPanel inside remember at line50, but the crash has not been reproduced with current Compose/Skiko/JavaFX/host versions.
recommended_next_step: Retain as risk/reproduction in NATIVE-018 with #39/#151; test cold/warm engine startup, composition reentry and explicit preinitialization on the correct threads.

title: Feature request: iOS-native styling customization for AdaptiveNavigationBar and AdaptiveTopBar
rationale: PR499 implements selected tint, pre-iOS26 unselected tint and title color only. Maintainer comment4184266309 leaves iOS26 unselected tint and title font/typography unchecked. Baseline configuration has no title typography field and explicitly documents the Liquid Glass unselected-color limitation.
recommended_next_step: Preserve only the remaining styling requirements; design optional typography/font-resource mapping and iOS26 appearance support without changing unspecified native defaults.

title: AdaptiveNavigationBar on iOS - bottom bar is visible when navigating away, and during back navigation gestures
rationale: Native bars are subviews of the shared host UIViewController while navigation transitions can keep multiple Compose destinations alive. The report and maintainer comment4967506597 describe a genuine integration gap; replacing navigation architecture was suggested, not implemented or authorized by this audit.

locations.symbol: native padding merged into Compose scaffold

recommended_next_step: Link UI transition/overlay finding; first reproduce Navigation3 outgoing/incoming-screen and cancelled-back-gesture cases, then evaluate scoped host/visibility fixes before a native-navigation redesign.

title: [Bug]:  AdaptiveTopBar (iOS): content top padding goes stale after device rotation
rationale: Source corroborates the report: native top-bar measurement uses LaunchedEffect(Unit), stops after stable frames, and has no rotation/window-size restart. Initial safe-area and cached heights are remembered, so later orientation changes can leave padding stale.
recommended_next_step: Link UI geometry finding and test portrait↔landscape, split view, safe-area changes and prefersLargeTitles transitions; observe view geometry rather than a one-shot warmup loop.

title: Fix file picker export and getPath; add onError, bookmarks and web save dialog
rationale: Open, unmerged upstream work. It proposes fixes to baseline export/data-loss/naming/path/cancel issues plus onError, metadata, bookmarks and a browser save dialog. It changes getPath semantics on mobile and includes author-reported tests; none of those claims or new APIs are baseline verification.
recommended_next_step: Keep preserved branch/ref; after audit triage, independently review commits/tests and cherry-pick narrowly scoped fixes where appropriate. Evaluate getPath deprecation/compatibility and real iOS/browser/device tests; do not bulk-merge or publish automatically.
